titulo.estudio: Lire un dossier de presse : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: Reading press coverage together: Vocabulary and forms

intro: Combine a news story, an official reaction and the testimony of someone affected. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Key words: reading press coverage together
Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Combine a news story, an official reaction and the testimony of someone affected. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: separate confirmed facts, statements and forecasts; attribute each claim to its source. In this passage, «annoncé» means «announced».

frases.estudio: Un communiqué précise que les bus seront déviés pendant trois semaines, le temps de renforcer la structure.
frases.alumno: A press release states that buses will be diverted for three weeks while the structure is reinforced.

frases.estudio: Une commerçante explique que les livraisons sont déjà retardées et demande une signalisation plus claire.
frases.alumno: A shopkeeper explains that deliveries are already being delayed and asks for clearer signs.

frases.estudio: La région a annoncé la fermeture temporaire du pont après une inspection menée mardi matin.
frases.alumno: The region announced the temporary closure of the bridge after an inspection carried out on Tuesday morning.
